description: Set up testing infrastructure (Vitest + React Testing Library + jsdom) and create a new git branch for the work
steps: Create and checkout a new branch feat/per-station-tag-notifications from current HEAD (which equals main)
Install dev dependencies: vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, @testing-library/user-event, jsdom, msw (for fetch mocking in Convex action tests)
Create vitest.config.ts at project root with: environment jsdom, globals true, path alias @/ -> src/, setupFiles pointing to a setup file
Create src/test/setup.ts that imports @testing-library/jest-dom for extended matchers
Add 'test': 'vitest run' and 'test:watch': 'vitest' scripts to package.json
Update tsconfig.json to include vitest/globals types in compilerOptions.types array
Create a trivial smoke test (e.g., src/test/smoke.test.ts) that verifies the test runner works
Run npx vitest run to confirm the test infrastructure works
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run executes successfully and the smoke test passes
TypeScript compilation (npx tsc --noEmit) still passes with the new config
Package.json has test and test:watch scripts
